WITH seg AS (
  SELECT c.Segment,
         SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2012,
         SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2013
  FROM yearmonth y
  JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
  SELECT Segment,
         (c2013 - c2012) * 100.0 / c2013 AS pct_increase
  FROM seg
)
SELECT
  (SELECT Segment FROM pct ORDER BY pct_increase DESC LIMIT 1) AS biggest_increase_segment,
  (SELECT Segment FROM pct ORDER BY pct_increase ASC LIMIT 1) AS lowest_increase_segment

    AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'

  FROM cards
)
SELECT c.id, pct.percentage
FROM cards c
CROSS JOIN pct
WHERE c.isStorySpotlight = 1 AND c.isTextless = 0
ORDER BY c.id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id)
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
JOIN rulings r ON r.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE l.format = 'premodern'
  AND r.text = 'This is a triggered mana ability.'
  AND c.side IS NULL

SELECT DISTINCT fd.name
FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data fd ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE fd.language = 'French'
  AND c.types = 'Creature'
  AND c.layout = 'normal'
  AND c.borderColor = 'black'
  AND c.artist = 'Matthew D. Wilson'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN fd.language = 'French' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(c.id) AS french_percentage
FROM cards AS c
INNER JOIN foreign_data AS fd ON c.uuid = fd.uuid
WHERE c.isStorySpotlight = 1
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN isTextless = 1 AND layout = 'normal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM cards
SELECT language FROM foreign_data WHERE multiverseid = 149934
SELECT DISTINCT language FROM foreign_data WHERE name = 'A Pedra Fellwar'
SELECT name FROM main.cards WHERE name IN ('Serra Angel', 'Shrine Keeper') ORDER BY convertedManaCost DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT st.language
FROM sets s
JOIN set_translations st ON st.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.mcmName = 'Archenemy' AND s.code = 'ARC'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FROM cards c JOIN set_translations st ON st.setCode = c.setCode WHERE st.translation = 'Hauptset Zehnte Edition' AND c.artist = 'Adam Rex'

SELECT DISTINCT st.translation
FROM cards c
JOIN set_translations st ON st.setCode = c.setCode
WHERE c.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen' AND st.language = 'Italian'
SELECT st.translation FROM sets s JOIN set_translations st ON st.setCode = s.code WHERE s.name = 'Eighth Edition' AND st.language = 'Chinese Simplified'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN fd.language = 'French' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM cards AS c INNER JOIN foreign_data AS fd ON c.uuid = fd.uuid WHERE c.power IS NULL OR c.power = '*'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.hasContentWarning = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(c.id) AS percentage
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE l.format = 'commander' AND l.status = 'Legal'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) FROM main.sets s JOIN main.set_translations st ON st.setCode = s.code WHERE s.block = 'Ice Age' AND st.language = 'Italian' AND st.translation IS NOT NULL
SELECT IIF(s.isForeignOnly = 1, 'YES', 'NO') FROM cards c JOIN sets s ON s.code = c.setCode WHERE c.name = 'Adarkar Valkyrie'

SELECT DISTINCT c.artist
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap'
  AND c.artist IN ('Jeremy Jarvis', 'Aaron Miller', 'Chippy')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FROM cards c JOIN sets s ON s.code = c.setCode WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap' AND c.convertedManaCost > 5 AND (c.power = '*' OR c.power IS NULL)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) FROM sets s JOIN set_translations t ON t.setCode = s.code WHERE t.language = 'Italian' AND t.translation IS NOT NULL AND s.baseSetSize < 100

SELECT DISTINCT s.name AS set_name, s.code, CASE WHEN s.mtgoCode IS NOT NULL THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS appeared_on_mtgo
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON s.code = c.setCode
WHERE c.name = 'Angel of Mercy'
SELECT DISTINCT fd.flavorText FROM foreign_data fd JOIN cards c ON fd.uuid = c.uuid WHERE c.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen' AND fd.language = 'Italian'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.convertedManaCost = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(c.id) FROM cards c JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND c.cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(c.id) FROM cards c JOIN sets s ON s.code = c.setCode WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap'

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM cards AS c
  JOIN set_translations AS st ON st.setCode = c.setCode
  WHERE c.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen'
    AND st.language = 'Korean'
    AND st.translation IS NOT NULL
) THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS has_korean_version

SELECT DISTINCT fd.text
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
JOIN foreign_data fd ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap' AND fd.language = 'Italian'

SELECT s.name
FROM sets s
WHERE s.code IN (SELECT setCode FROM set_translations WHERE language = 'Korean')
  AND s.code NOT IN (SELECT setCode FROM set_translations WHERE language LIKE '%Japanese%' AND setCode IS NOT NULL)

SELECT c.name, l.format
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.edhrecRank = 1
  AND l.status = 'Banned'
SELECT bond_type FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT fd.name
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON s.code = c.setCode
JOIN foreign_data fd ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap'
  AND fd.language = 'Italian'
  AND c.convertedManaCost = (
    SELECT MAX(c2.convertedManaCost)
    FROM cards c2
    JOIN sets s2 ON s2.code = c2.setCode
    WHERE s2.name = 'Coldsnap'
  )
SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id FROM molecule m JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '+'

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) FROM (SELECT T1.atom_id, COUNT(T2.bond_type) AS single_bond_count FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T3.molecule_id = T1.molecule_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '-' AND T3.label = '+' GROUP BY T1.atom_id) AS subquery

WITH banned_counts AS (
  SELECT format, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM legalities
  WHERE status = 'Banned'
  GROUP BY format
),
top_format AS (
  SELECT format
  FROM banned_counts
  WHERE cnt = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM banned_counts)
)
SELECT DISTINCT l.format, c.name
FROM legalities l
JOIN top_format t ON t.format = l.format
JOIN cards c ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE l.status = 'Banned'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(a.atom_id)
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '=')

SELECT DISTINCT c.name, l.format
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE s.name = 'Hour of Devastation'
  AND l.status = 'Legal'
SELECT DISTINCT a.element FROM bond b JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 WHERE b.bond_type = '='

SELECT DISTINCT a.element FROM connected c JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9' UNION SELECT DISTINCT a.element FROM connected c JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9'
SELECT m.label FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 'h' GROUP BY m.label ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(oxygen_count) AS avg_oxygen_atoms
FROM (
  SELECT m.molecule_id,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom a
          WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a.element = 'o') AS oxygen_count
  FROM molecule m
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bond b
                WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = '-')
) t

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY COUNT(a.atom_id) ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_type
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE (c.atom_id = 'TR004_8' AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR004_20')
   OR (c.atom_id = 'TR004_20' AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR004_8')

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN m.molecule_id END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS percent FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000' ORDER BY element LIMIT 3
SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(bond_id), 5) AS percent FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR008'
SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent FROM molecule
SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(atom_id), 4) AS percent FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR206'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 'i' THEN a.atom_id END) AS iodine_nums,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 's' THEN a.atom_id END) AS sulfur_nums
FROM atom AS a
INNER JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'

SELECT DISTINCT c.frameVersion, c.name, CASE WHEN l.status = 'Banned' THEN c.name ELSE 'NO' END AS banned_card
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE c.artist = 'Allen Williams'

SELECT b.bond_type, m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR010'
GROUP BY b.bond_type, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT a.element, m.label FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR060'

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
         SELECT 1 FROM atom a
         WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a.element = 'f'
       ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.label = '+'
SELECT COUNT(T2.bond_id) FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR009' AND (T2.atom_id = 'TR009_12' OR T2.atom_id2 = 'TR009_12')
SELECT COUNT(bond_id) FROM connected WHERE atom_id LIKE 'TR%_19'
SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2 FROM bond b JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9'
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004'
SELECT DISTINCT T2.molecule_id FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE SUBSTR(T1.atom_id, 7, 2) BETWEEN '21' AND '25' AND T2.label = '+'

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN (
  SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bond
  WHERE bond_type = '='
  GROUP BY molecule_id
  ORDER BY cnt DESC
  LIMIT 1
) t ON t.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

SELECT DISTINCT c.bond_id
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE (a1.element = 'p' AND a2.element = 'n')
   OR (a1.element = 'n' AND a2.element = 'p')
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected)
SELECT CAST(COUNT(T2.bond_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.atom_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T1.element = 'i'

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND b.bond_type = '#'

SELECT a.element FROM connected c JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR144_8_19' UNION SELECT a.element FROM connected c JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR144_8_19'
SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(b.bond_id), 5) FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '-'

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'

SELECT COUNT(T1.atom_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id WHERE T3.bond_type = '#' AND T1.element IN ('p', 'br')

SELECT a.element FROM connected c JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11'
UNION
SELECT a.element FROM connected c JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS percent FROM atom a JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS percentage FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.element FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.label = '+' AND SUBSTR(T1.atom_id, -1) = '4' AND LENGTH(T1.atom_id) = 7

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(a.element) AS ratio, m.label FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR006' GROUP BY m.label

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(a.atom_id) > 5
SELECT s.CDSCode FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN frpm AS f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE f."Enrollment (K-12)" + f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 500

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode)
FROM satscores AS t
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE t.AvgScrMath > 400 AND s.Virtual = 'F'

SELECT T1.School, T1.Street
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 30

SELECT MAX(CAST(f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" AS REAL) / f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)")
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE CAST(s.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / s.NumTstTakr > 0.3

SELECT s.CharterNum, sat.AvgScrWrite, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sat.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS WritingScoreRank
FROM satscores sat
JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE sat.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND s.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
SELECT T2.`School Name` FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE CAST(T2.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` AS REAL) / T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.1 AND T1.NumGE1500 > 0

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM satscores AS sa
JOIN schools AS s ON sa.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.School, s.FundingType
HAVING CAST(SUM(sa.AvgScrMath) AS REAL) / COUNT(sa.cds) > 400

SELECT T1.`School Name`, T2.Street, T2.City, T2.State, T2.Zip FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Monterey' AND T1.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800 AND T1.`School Type` = 'High Schools (Public)'
SELECT CAST(`Free Meal Count (K-12)` AS REAL) / `Enrollment (K-12)` FROM frpm ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9
SELECT s.School, sa.AvgScrWrite, s.Phone FROM schools s JOIN satscores sa ON sa.cds = s.CDSCode WHERE strftime('%Y', s.OpenDate) > '1991' OR strftime('%Y', s.ClosedDate) < '2000'

SELECT CAST(f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS REAL) / f."Enrollment (K-12)"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT s.School, s.DOCType
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > (
    SELECT AVG(f2."Enrollment (K-12)" - f2."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)")
    FROM frpm AS f2
    JOIN schools AS s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
    WHERE s2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  )

SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State
FROM satscores AS t
JOIN schools AS s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE t.NumTstTakr > 0 AND t.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CAST(t.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / t.NumTstTakr ASC
LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(sa.NumTstTakr) FROM satscores AS sa JOIN schools AS s ON sa.cds = s.CDSCode WHERE s.County = 'Fresno' AND strftime('%Y', s.OpenDate) = '1980'

SELECT s.Phone
FROM satscores AS t
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE s.District = 'Fresno Unified'
  AND t.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY t.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT s.School,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY t.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rnk
  FROM schools s
  JOIN satscores t ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
  WHERE s.Virtual = 'F' AND t.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT School FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 5

SELECT T2.School
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.DOC = '31'
ORDER BY T1."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN DOC = '54' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN DOC = '52' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM schools WHERE StatusType = 'Merged' AND County = 'Orange'
SELECT CAST(COUNT(School) AS REAL) / 12 FROM schools WHERE DOC = '52' AND County = 'Alameda' AND strftime('%Y', OpenDate) = '1980'
SELECT T2.MailStreet, T2.School FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.AvgScrMath DESC LIMIT 6, 1

SELECT COUNT(s.CDSCode)
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND s.Charter = 0
  AND CAST(f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" AS REAL) * 100 / f."Enrollment (K-12)" < 0.18

SELECT s.School, sat.AvgScrWrite
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND s.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich'
SELECT GSoffered FROM schools WHERE Longitude IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ABS(Longitude) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.School, T1."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" * 100 / T1."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Los Angeles' AND T2.GSserved = 'K-9'

SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS num_schools
FROM schools
WHERE County IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara') AND Virtual = 'F'
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY num_schools DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.AdmFName1, s.AdmLName1, s.AdmFName2, s.AdmLName2, s.AdmFName3, s.AdmLName3
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE t.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY t.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT T2."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.EdOpsCode = 'SSS' AND T1.City = 'Fremont' AND T2."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'

SELECT T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS percent_eligible_free_k12, T1.`District Code` FROM frpm AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine'

SELECT T2.City, COUNT(T2.CDSCode) AS num_schools FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.Magnet = 1 AND T2.GSoffered = 'K-8' AND T1."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Multiple Provision Types' GROUP BY T2.City

SELECT AdmEmail1
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'San Bernardino'
  AND District = 'San Bernardino City Unified'
  AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'
  AND SOC = '62'
  AND DOC = '54'
  AND AdmEmail1 IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.A3 = 'east Bohemia' AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.district_id) FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T1.gender = 'F' AND T2.A11 BETWEEN 6000 AND 10000
SELECT l.account_id FROM loan AS l JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id WHERE l.duration > 12 AND STRFTIME('%Y', a.date) = '1993' ORDER BY l.amount DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A3 = 'north Bohemia'
  AND d.A11 > 8000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN district di ON di.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', c.birth_date) < '1950'
  AND di.A2 = 'Sokolov'

WITH weekly_1997_loans AS (
  SELECT l.account_id, l.amount
  FROM loan AS l
  JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
  WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1997'
    AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
)
SELECT DISTINCT account_id
FROM weekly_1997_loans
WHERE amount = (SELECT MIN(amount) FROM weekly_1997_loans)

SELECT DISTINCT d.A2
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date = '1976-01-29'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(amount) FROM loan

SELECT d.account_id
FROM disp AS d
WHERE d.client_id = (
  SELECT c.client_id
  FROM client AS c
  JOIN district AS di ON di.district_id = c.district_id
  ORDER BY c.birth_date DESC, di.A11 DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(c.client_id) FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A3 = 'south Bohemia' ORDER BY CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1)

WITH oldest_female AS (
  SELECT c.client_id, d.A11
  FROM client c
  JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC, d.A11 ASC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT dp.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - o.A11 AS salary_gap
